findings.reason: The cited evidence shows a stadium event near S-TUN-001 and traffic spikes on three sites, supporting the inference that the event caused the surge.
T4 shows S-TUN-002 onset at 18:15, but S-TUN-001 and S-TUN-003 onsets are at 18:30, contradicting the claim that all started at 18:15.
EVT-002 and T9 explicitly state the event occurred between 18:12 and 22:02 near S-TUN-001 at the Rades Olympic complex.
T3 explicitly reports no maintenance windows scheduled on the specified sites and parents during the stated window.
The temporal correlation between the event (18:12-22:02) and the traffic surge (18:15-22:00) on nearby sites makes this a reasonable inference.
